# v2.4.0 "Gloss"

A gloss is a translation written beside the text. This release makes the web
UI translatable, and adds per-user content restrictions, configurable reader
tap zones, backlog estimates at your own pace, and connection settings you can
change on the device.

## Highlights

**The web UI speaks other languages.** A language picker under Settings →
Appearance. English stays the source; every other language is a

English
